summary.text: John Mancinelli is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 161, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Leanne Krueger.
He has served on the Penn-Delco School District board since 2022 and ran for the same House seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: John Mancinelli has held an at-large seat on the Penn-Delco School District board since 2022.
He was the Republican nominee for District 161 in 2024, when Krueger defeated him, 58.1% to 41.7%.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, setting up a rematch with Krueger.
